{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999].copy()

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df_filtered.loc[df_filtered.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the resulting dataframe
df_dedup.info()

# Check the distribution of arm and severity
df_arm_severity = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'], margins=True)
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity after deduplication:\")
print(df_arm_severity)

# Check the distribution of sex in the treatment arm
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']
df_treatment_sex = pd.crosstab(df_treatment['sex'], df_treatment['responded'], margins=True)
print("\nCross-tabulation of sex vs responded in treatment arm:\")
print(df_treatment_sex)"}
